answer:
I think you have several problems here.

  1. I believe you should move if execute outside of the macro.
{% macro mac_em_edw_delta_attributes(em_schema_in,em_table_in,edw_schema_in,edw_table_in,exclude_columns_in) %}
...
{% set var_sql_resut = run_query(var_sql_stmt) %}
{{ return(var_sql_resut) }}    
--end maco
{% endmacro %}

{% set var_sql_resuts_out = mac_em_edw_delta_attributes(var_em_schema,var_em_table,var_edw_schema,var_edw_table,var_exclude_columns) %}
{% if execute %}
{% set var_columns_list_em_out = var_sql_resuts_out.columns[0].values()[0] %}
{% set var_columns_list_edw_out = var_sql_resuts_out.columns[1].values()[0] %}
{% set var_columns_select_out = var_sql_resuts_out.columns[2].values()[0] %}
{% set var_columns_expr_out = var_sql_resuts_out.columns[3].values()[0] %}
{% else %}
{% set var_columns_list_em_out = '' %}
{% set var_columns_list_edw_out = '' %}
{% set var_columns_select_out = '' %}
{% set var_columns_expr_out = '' %}
{% endif %}
  1. You select different rows of the first column, not different columns of the first row.

{% set var_columns_list_edw_out = var_sql_resuts_out.columns[1].values()[0] %}
